name: MEWS 22
premise: One cream mews house on a cobbled lane in Mayfair, London, for sale; a room-by-room tour and a private viewing.
look: classic London property photography: soft overcast and early-morning light, glossy paint, wet cobbles, quiet elegance, 35mm, photorealistic
palette: cream stucco, gloss black, London brick, wisteria lilac and brass
direction: A small house with a big address. The photography is quiet and precise, London-soft: wisteria, a glossy black door, wet cobbles after rain, then calm contemporary rooms inside old proportions. Small human moments (a dog walk, a delivery of flowers) make it feel like a real street.
type: classic book serif with small caps; lots of white; a deep black for the door colour as the accent.
anchor: a two-storey London mews house of cream-painted stucco on a narrow cobbled lane, a glossy black front door with a brass knocker under a semicircular fanlight, black-framed sash windows with window boxes of white flowers, wisteria in full lilac bloom climbing the facade, a glossy black carriage door to the garage, neighbouring mews houses in soft pastel colours
consistency: Generate 01 first; keep the house description word for word.
Interiors share pale oak, plaster mouldings, linen, brass and soft London daylight.
